title: Garzicor's Corpse and Wraith
summary: Release Garzicor through a corpse battle followed by his wraith.
overview: Release Garzicor through a corpse battle followed by his wraith.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Complete the ghostly presence’s summoning sequence to bring out Garzicor’s Corpse.
Defeat the corpse within its twenty-minute availability window. Its death summons Garzicor’s Wraith.
The wraith remains for thirty minutes. Defeat it, then speak with the resulting shade to continue the quest.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
